<?xml version="1.0"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2011/08/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Simulation.Aivika.Charting.Gtk</id>
    <version>3.1.17.0</version>
    <authors>David Sorokin</authors>
    <owners>David Sorokin</owners>
    <licenseUrl>https://github.com/dsorokin/aivika-fsharp-ce/blob/master/LICENSE</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>http://www.aivikasoft.com/en/products/aivika-fsharp.html</projectUrl>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>true</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <description>The charting components allow visualizing the results of simulation on Linux and OS X. You can plot the deviation chart, histogram, time series and XY chart.</description>
    <summary>Charting components of the Aivika simulation library for Linux and OS X.</summary>
    <releaseNotes>A new version of the package.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright 2009-2016</copyright>
    <tags>discrete-event simulation system-dynamics agent-based modeling</tags>
    <dependencies>
      <dependency id="Simulation.Aivika" version="3.1.17.0" />
      <dependency id="OxyPlot.Core" version="2014.1.546" />
      <dependency id="OxyPlot.GtkSharp" version="2014.1.546" />
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
